name: TicketContract

methods.name: create_event
methods.desc: Configure event details. Only callable by contract creator.

methods.name: purchase_ticket
methods.desc:
Purchase a ticket - mints NFT and transfers to buyer.
Returns: Asset ID of the minted ticket NFT

methods.name: list_for_resale
methods.desc: List a ticket for resale on the secondary market.

methods.name: buy_resale_ticket
methods.desc: Buy from resale - transfers NFT to buyer.

methods.name: mark_scanned
methods.desc: Mark a ticket as scanned at event entrance.

methods.name: is_scanned
methods.desc: Check if a ticket has been scanned.

methods.name: get_event_info
methods.desc: Retrieve event information for frontend display.

desc:
An event ticketing smart contract with purchase, transfer, and resale capabilities.
    
    Manages ticket sales for events with price controls, royalties for organizers,
    and per-user purchase limits.

tickets_purchased.desc: Number of tickets purchased by this user (max 5)

sourceInfo.errorMessage: Event capacity must be greater than 0
Max resale multiplier must be at least 100 (100%)
Only contract creator can create event
Only event organizer can scan tickets
Ticket price must be greater than 0
can only call when not creating
